subject: Water shut off since Monday - nobody has called me back
redacted_body: My water has been shut off since Monday morning and it is now Thursday. I have called your support line three times and every time I am told someone will call me back. Nobody has. I have a newborn at home and we are buying bottled water just to wash bottles. I paid my bill on time, I can send you the receipt. This is completely unacceptable. You can reach me at [REDACTED]. I want my water back on TODAY and I want to know why this happened.
